label: Aerial Location
description: Scenes meant to be seen from above. Tagged 'aerial'; pair with the drone viewpoint.

items.name: patchwork-farmland
items.text: A quilt of farmland from above, contrasting field colors stitched together by hedgerows and a winding lane.

items.name: coastal-switchbacks
items.text: A cliffside coastal road folding through hairpin switchbacks high above turquoise coves.

items.name: river-delta-veins
items.text: A braided river delta spreading like silver veins through dark wetlands toward the sea.

items.name: manhattan-grid
items.text: The rectilinear canyon grid of a dense city center from directly overhead, rooftops and moving traffic in miniature.

items.name: container-port
items.text: A container port from above, candy-colored containers in perfect rows beside gantry cranes and a docked ship.

items.name: alpine-ridgeline
items.text: A knife-edge alpine ridgeline from above, glaciers pouring off both flanks into shadowed valleys.

items.name: atoll-lagoon
items.text: A ring-shaped coral atoll enclosing a gradient lagoon of impossible blues.

items.name: interchange-knot
items.text: A multi-level motorway interchange from above, sweeping ramps knotted into concrete calligraphy.
